description: List recent videos, shorts, or streams from a YouTube channel or TikTok/Instagram profile. Listing costs 0 credits; optional transcripts=true expands up to 10 videos inline and bills normal transcript credits per delivered video.

chunks.description: Split transcript into o200k_base token chunks (true for defaults, or { max_tokens, overlap_tokens }).

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous listing.

engine.description: Transcript engine for inline expansion; defaults to captions.

max_transcripts.description: Maximum videos to expand when transcripts=true (default 5, max 10).

platform.description: Optional platform hint for bare handles.

since_video_id.description: Stop listing once this video ID is reached (YouTube).

transcripts.description: When true, expand transcripts inline for returned videos (billed normally).

url.description: Channel URL, @handle, or UC... YouTube channel ID.

name: transcriptlab_list_channel_videos
title: List channel videos
